title: Harness Lab
blurb: Curated tips and methods that make this Field Brief / EM fleet stronger — Grok bots, Mac CLIs, Obsidian vault, routines, and launch standards. Keep only what we can apply; not generic AI news.

entries.title: Harness engineering: Codex in an agent-first world (OpenAI)
entries.why: Repo/docs as system of record: short indexes, durable specs/plans, decision logs, linted invariants, doc-gardening. Maps onto our EM intent/spec/plan + dual-LGTM and vault Decisions.

entries.title: How we built our multi-agent research system (Anthropic)
entries.why: Lead plans → fan-out collectors → persist artifacts → synthesize + citation-check. Direct template for Field Brief collect→brief→publish and Manage CoS effort budgets.

entries.title: Orchestrate teams of Claude Code sessions (docs)
entries.why: Lead/teammate, shared task list, messaging, tmux splits, idle/complete hooks — concrete patterns for our group rooms + Mac CLI fleet ops.

entries.title: Watchdog — local operator control plane for agentic loops
entries.why: KEEP optional for Codex/Astra observe (Mac 2026-09-16: observe --once works; doctor still crashes). Do not replace grok-tmux-watchdog fleet-wide.

entries.title: receipt — itemized AI coding-agent cost on PRs
entries.why: KEEP for Coding EM (Claude import). Mac spike 2026-09-16 on BQAA: $172.17 / 2614 calls; sample branch $64.48. Prefer show --branch. Fleet CI + Codex proxy still DEFER. Unpriced: claude-fable-5-1.

entries.title: Blind second reviewer (Claude Forge adversarial loop)
entries.why: Blind dual-LGTM on our team is now Astra + Fable (independent kickoffs; implementer ≠ reviewer). Applied 2026-09-16.

entries.title: Multi-agent coordination patterns (Anthropic)
entries.why: Names orchestrator/router failure modes — especially silent misroute. Action for us: ambiguous route → ask Haiyuan, never silent SendToAgent.

entries.title: Chief-of-staff intake + visible group rooms
entries.why: Route default asks through Agent Manage Bot; use Field Brief and Coding EM rooms when the handoff itself must be visible. Written handoff contracts (goal, owner, artifact path, return shape) cut silent dropoffs between Manage and specialists.

entries.title: Routine fire proxy on the usage dashboard
entries.why: Until Cursor ships per-bot pool meters, estimate cron fires/week from Active routine dumps (Collection + Github + Manage). Label PROXY — not dollars or tokens — so we can pause overlap before weekly % spikes.

entries.title: Box ↔ Mac vault staging when FS is dark
entries.why: Mac vault path is source of truth. When the Grok box cannot see Mac FS, stage under /workspace/…, mark STAGED ON BOX, then copy when machineId is connected. Shared Grok computer ≠ trust isolation.

entries.title: Field Brief miss-watch as second line
entries.why: Collection owns :44 auto catch-up if the :34 deep brief is missing; Manage :50 room ping is second-line visibility only — publish stays with Collection. Pattern: miss-watch + owning publisher, not duplicate publishers.
